english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for enthusiasm or thrills, and in a clearly sexual context it can also mean sexually aroused.
Use this when the elation especially involves excitement or heightened energy.
Use 興奮 when “crazy” means extremely excited or enthusiastic rather than mentally unsound.
Use this when the enthusiasm specifically emphasizes excitement or an emotionally stirred-up state.

examples.english: I'm really excited about going on a trip tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 我聽日去旅行，真係好興奮。

examples.english: I’m so elated about going on holiday tomorrow that I can’t sleep.
